purpose: READ-ONLY, per-provider account-fact snapshot with provider and account_scope kept as explicit, separate fields (unlike v1's single conflated 'source' string). NOT a sizing/policy decision -- this contract never computes or ratifies a risk-budget percentage, a stop-loss cap, or a position size.
coexists_with: portfolio_risk_input/1 (portfolio_risk/portfolio_snapshot.py) -- v1 is unmodified and remains the only contract Alpaca capture uses. This is an independent, additive contract for new providers, starting with KIS PAPER.

real_data_persistence.note: This repo is PUBLIC. No real NAV/cash/positions/account_identity_hash produced by this contract's code path is ever written to any file, committed or otherwise, here. Real capture and persistence happen entirely inside the private atlas-private-evidence repo's own root-only Ubuntu runtime state, never in this repo, never in GitHub Actions.

cross_provider_aggregation.note: Combining a v2 account fact (e.g. KIS_PAPER_ACCOUNT/KOREA) with v1 account facts (e.g. ALPACA_PAPER_ACCOUNT/US) into one packet-level risk_capacity_inputs computation is a separate, later decision and is not defined by this file.
